PYQ-2022-GS-151.q: To what does Valluvar compare the wealth of a wise and generous man (பேரறிவாளன்) that benefits society?
PYQ-2022-GS-151.e: 'ஊருணி நீர்நிறைந் தற்றே உலகவாம் பேரறி வாளன் திரு' (Kural 215, Oppuravarithal). Just as a full village tank from which everyone draws water, the wealth of a wise man who loves the world benefits all.

PYQ-2022-GS-152.q: Which organisation is NOT associated with Tamil Nadu's first Multi-Modal Logistics Park?
PYQ-2022-GS-152.e: Tamil Nadu's first Multi-Modal Logistics Park at Mappedu, Tiruvallur district, is a joint project of NHLML, the Chennai Port Authority and TIDCO among others; the Chennai Metropolitan Development Authority (CMDA) is not a partner (answer key).

PYQ-2022-GS-153.q: Who won the Jnanpith Award for the year 2021?
PYQ-2022-GS-153.e: The 56th Jnanpith Award, for 2021, went to Assamese poet Nilmani Phookan. The 57th award, for 2022, announced the same day (7 December 2021), went to Konkani writer Damodar Mauzo. Amitav Ghosh – 54th (2018). TNPSC's final answer key also gives 'D – Nilmani Phookan'.

PYQ-2022-GS-154.q: The constitutional amendment passed by Parliament to restore the power of States to prepare their own lists of Other Backward Classes amended which three Articles?
PYQ-2022-GS-154.e: The 105th Constitutional Amendment (2021) amended Articles 338B, 342A and 366 and restored to the States the power to prepare lists of socially and educationally backward classes (after the Maratha reservation judgment).

PYQ-2022-GS-155.q:
Which of the following statements are correct?
(i) The Central Drug Research Institute (CDRI) has indigenously developed an RT-PCR kit called 'Om' to detect the Omicron variant of coronavirus.
(ii) 'Om' is the first kit developed by a government institution specifically for testing Omicron.
(iii) 'Om' is the third indigenously made coronavirus (Omicron) test kit.
PYQ-2022-GS-155.e: CSIR-Central Drug Research Institute (CDRI), Lucknow, developed the 'Om' RT-PCR kit to specifically detect Omicron in January 2022; it is the first Omicron test kit developed by a government institution and the third indigenous Omicron kit. All three are correct (answer key).

PYQ-2022-GS-156.q: The three rivers of Peninsular India that flow from east to west are
PYQ-2022-GS-156.e: The Narmada, Tapti and Mahi (and Sabarmati) flow west into the Arabian Sea; the Narmada and Tapti flow through rift valleys and form estuaries. The Mahanadi, Godavari and Krishna flow east into the Bay of Bengal and form deltas.

PYQ-2022-GS-157.e: Purines = adenine and guanine (double ring) — correct. Pyrimidines = cytosine, thymine and uracil. Nucleoside = nitrogenous base + sugar; nucleotide = nucleoside + phosphate. So the other pairs are wrong.

PYQ-2022-GS-158.q: What is the gas trapped in the pores of soft sedimentary rock layers called?
PYQ-2022-GS-158.e: Natural gas trapped in the tiny pores of shale — a soft, finely layered sedimentary rock — is called 'shale gas'. Gobar gas is biogas obtained from cow dung.

PYQ-2022-GS-159.q:
Match the compound with its functional group:
(a) Alcohol – 1. –COOH
(b) Aldehyde – 2. –OH
(c) Ketone – 3. –CHO
(d) Carboxylic acid – 4. –CO– (C=O)
PYQ-2022-GS-159.e: Alcohol – hydroxyl –OH (2); aldehyde – –CHO (3); ketone – carbonyl >C=O (4); carboxylic acid – –COOH (1). Hence 2, 3, 4, 1.

PYQ-2022-GS-160.q: Hydraulic lifts used in vehicle service stations to raise vehicles work on the basis of which law?
PYQ-2022-GS-160.e: Pascal's law: pressure applied at one point of an enclosed fluid is transmitted equally in all directions. Hydraulic lifts and hydraulic brakes work on this principle.

PYQ-2022-GS-161.q: Which of the following is NOT an equation for force?
PYQ-2022-GS-161.e: Newton's second law: force = rate of change of momentum = ΔP/t = m(v − u)/t = ma. 'ΔP × t' is not an equation for force (impulse = F × t = ΔP).

PYQ-2022-GS-162.q:
Match the adulterant with its use in food.
(a) Hydrogen peroxide – 1. Glossy appearance
(b) Food colouring – 2. Milk
(c) Calcium carbide – 3. Green appearance
(d) Carnauba wax – 4. Ripening bananas
PYQ-2022-GS-162.e: Hydrogen peroxide – added to milk to stop it spoiling (2); food colours – give vegetables a green look (3); calcium carbide – artificial ripening of bananas (4); carnauba wax – gives fruits a glossy look (1). Hence 2, 3, 4, 1.

PYQ-2022-GS-163.q:
Match:
(a) Sivasubramanianar – 1. Kayathar fort
(b) Kattabomman – 2. Sankagiri fort
(c) Marudhu Brothers – 3. Nagalapuram
(d) Dheeran Chinnamalai – 4. Tiruppattur fort
PYQ-2022-GS-163.e: Places where they were executed: Kattabomman's minister Sivasubramanianar – Nagalapuram (3); Kattabomman – Kayathar (1799) (1); Marudhu Brothers – Tiruppattur fort (1801) (4); Dheeran Chinnamalai – Sankagiri fort (1805) (2). Hence 3, 1, 4, 2.

o: Shivaji was crowned at Raigad fort
In 1674 he was crowned with the title Chhatrapati
PYQ-2022-GS-164.e: Shivaji sacked Surat in 1664 (and again in 1670), not 1665 — so this is the incorrect statement. Dadaji Kondadev was his guardian-teacher; in 1674 he was crowned 'Chhatrapati' with great ceremony at Raigad. (Note: the original option used an unclear name 'Rajkosh', so TNPSC's final key also accepted B; it has been clarified here as Raigad.)

PYQ-2022-GS-165.q:
Identify the correct statements.
1. Bharathi's weekly 'India' was the voice of the Moderate nationalists.
2. Bharathi attended the Surat Congress session in 1907.
3. Bharathi worked in journals such as Chakravarthini and Swadesamitran.
4. The Hindu was published by G. Subramania Iyer.
PYQ-2022-GS-165.e: Bharathi's 'India' was the voice of the Extremists, not the Moderates (1 wrong). Bharathi attended the 1907 Surat session (2); he worked in 'Chakravarthini' and 'Swadesamitran' (3); G. Subramania Iyer was the chief founder of 'The Hindu' (1878) (4).

PYQ-2022-GS-166.q:
Choose the correct statements.
(i) The Palayakkarar system was in practice in the Kakatiya kingdom.
(ii) After the death of Khan Sahib, Puli Thevar recaptured Nerkattumseval in 1764.
(iii) Yusuf Khan was charged as a traitor for negotiating with the Palayakkarars without informing the Company administration and was hanged in 1764.
(iv) Ondiveeran led one of the army divisions of Kattabomman.
PYQ-2022-GS-166.e: The Palayakkarar system originated in the Kakatiya kingdom (Prataparudra) (i correct). After Yusuf Khan (Khan Sahib) was hanged in 1764, Puli Thevar recovered Nerkattumseval (ii and iii correct). Ondiveeran was Puli Thevar's commander, not Kattabomman's (iv wrong).

PYQ-2022-GS-167.q:
Read the passage and answer:
The formation of the Swadeshi Steam Navigation Company marked a remarkable development in the history of the freedom movement. Eager to revive the shipbuilding tradition of the Tamils, to give people practical training in shipbuilding, and determined to challenge the British monopoly in sea transport, V.O. Chidambaram announced in 1906 his decision to form a navigation company.

Which of the following is specifically stated in the passage?
o: The Steam Navigation Company earned good revenue in those days.
The formation of the Swadeshi Steam Navigation Company ended the British monopoly in sea trade.
V.O. Chidambaram depended on others for any decision regarding the navigation company.
Reviving the Tamils' knowledge of the shipbuilding tradition was an aim of forming the navigation company.
PYQ-2022-GS-167.e: The passage says the company was formed 'eager to revive the shipbuilding tradition of the Tamils'. Revenue, ending the monopoly (the passage says 'challenge', not 'ended') and depending on others are not stated in the passage.

PYQ-2022-GS-168.q:
Match the types of land in the Gupta period.
(a) Kshetra – 1. Waste land
(b) Khila – 2. Cultivable land
(c) Aprahata – 3. Habitable land
(d) Vasti – 4. Forest land
PYQ-2022-GS-168.e: Gupta-period land types: Kshetra – cultivable land (2); Khila – waste land (1); Aprahata – forest land (4); Vasti – habitable land (3). (Gopata Saraha – pasture land.) Hence 2, 1, 4, 3.

PYQ-2022-GS-169.q:
Which of the following statements about NITI Aayog is correct?
I. All State Chief Ministers, except those of Union Territories with legislatures, are members of the Governing Council.
II. The Prime Minister of India is the Chairperson of NITI Aayog.
III. The Finance Minister of India serves as Vice-Chairperson.
PYQ-2022-GS-169.e: The Prime Minister is the Chairperson of NITI Aayog (II correct). Its Governing Council includes all State Chief Ministers, Chief Ministers of Union Territories with legislatures and Lieutenant Governors of other UTs — so 'except UTs with legislatures' is wrong (I wrong). The Vice-Chairperson is appointed by the PM; it is not the Finance Minister (III wrong).

PYQ-2022-GS-170.q:
Assertion (A): The Reserve Bank of India controls the money supply in the economy.
Reason (R): It wants to stabilise the foreign exchange rate and control inflation.
o: (A) is true; but (R) is not the correct explanation of (A)
Both (A) and (R) are true, and (R) is the correct explanation of (A)
PYQ-2022-GS-170.e: Through monetary policy the RBI controls the money supply; price stability (controlling inflation) and stabilising the exchange rate are its aims. Both are true; the Reason explains the Assertion (answer key).

PYQ-2022-GS-171.q:
Assertion (A): Micro-irrigation technology gives higher crop yields than traditional irrigation methods.
Reason (R): In micro-irrigation, a measured quantity of water is supplied at regular intervals. It reduces labour cost, increases fertiliser-use efficiency and increases yield.
o: (A) and (R) are true, and (R) is the correct explanation of (A)
(A) and (R) are true, but (R) is not the correct explanation of (A)
PYQ-2022-GS-171.e: Micro-irrigation such as drip and sprinkler systems supplies a measured amount of water to the root zone at regular intervals, cutting water waste, weeds and labour cost; fertiliser can be applied with the water, so yields rise. Both are true and the Reason explains the Assertion. (Note: a printing error/omission in the original paper has been corrected.)

PYQ-2022-AP-173.q:
Two positions of a die are given:
Position 1: top face 2; visible side faces 3, 5
Position 2: top face 5; visible side faces 2, 4
Which number is on the face opposite 3?
PYQ-2022-AP-173.e: Position 1: 3 and 5 are adjacent to 2. Position 2: 2 and 4 are adjacent to 5; also 4 is adjacent to 2. So 3, 4, 5 are adjacent to 2 ⇒ the face opposite 2 is 1 or 6; and 2, 3, 4 are adjacent to 5 ⇒ the face opposite 5 is also 1 or 6. With 1 and 6 opposite 2 and 5, the remaining 3 and 4 are opposite each other. Answer: 4.

PYQ-2022-AP-174.e: These are squares of consecutive prime numbers: 7² = 49, 11² = 121, 13² = 169, 17² = 289, 19² = 361. (225 = 15², and 15 is not prime.)

PYQ-2022-AP-175.q: One side of a rectangle is 5 cm and its diagonal is 13 cm. Find the area of the rectangle.

PYQ-2022-AP-176.q: A man was engaged for a certain job. He was absent for a few days and received ₹1,387 as wages for the days he worked. Had he worked on all the days, he would have received ₹1,752. For how many days did he work?
PYQ-2022-AP-176.e: The daily wage must divide both amounts exactly: HCF (1387, 1752) = 73 (1387 = 73 × 19; 1752 = 73 × 24). So the daily wage is ₹73 and he worked 19 days (24 days in all, absent 5 days).

PYQ-2022-AP-177.q: The product of three numbers is 1875 and their HCF is 5. Find their LCM.
PYQ-2022-AP-177.e: Let the numbers be 5a, 5b, 5c (a, b, c with no common factor). Then 125abc = 1875 ⇒ abc = 15. Possible sets are (1, 3, 5) or (1, 1, 15) — in both cases LCM = 5 × 15 = 75. E.g. 5, 15, 25: product 1875, HCF 5, LCM 75.

PYQ-2022-AP-178.q: 94 is divided into two parts such that one-fifth of the first part and one-eighth of the second part are in the ratio 3 : 4. Find the first part.

PYQ-2022-AP-179.q: Number codes for letters: R = 1, M = 2, E = 3, N = 4, B = 5, U = 6. If these letters are rearranged, a meaningful English word is formed. Find the number code for that word.
PYQ-2022-AP-179.e: The meaningful word formed from R, M, E, N, B, U is NUMBER. N = 4, U = 6, M = 2, B = 5, E = 3, R = 1 ⇒ 462531.

PYQ-2022-AP-180.q: How many times can you subtract 10 from 100?
PYQ-2022-AP-180.e: This is a logic puzzle: once you subtract 10 from 100, it becomes 90; after that you are subtracting from 90, not from 100. So you can subtract 10 from 100 only once.

PYQ-2022-AP-181.q: Mukesh completes 2/7 of a piece of work in one day. In how many days will he complete the whole work?
PYQ-2022-AP-181.e: Days for the whole work = 1 ÷ (2/7) = 7/2 = 3½ days.

PYQ-2022-AP-182.q: A farmer borrows ₹20,000 at 4.5% per annum simple interest. What amount must he pay after five years to clear the loan completely?
PYQ-2022-AP-182.e: Simple interest = 20000 × 4.5 × 5 / 100 = ₹4,500. Total amount to be paid = 20000 + 4500 = ₹24,500. (₹4,500 is only the interest.)

PYQ-2022-AP-183.q: The difference between the simple interests received from two different sources on ₹1,500 for 3 years is ₹13.50. Find the difference between their rates of interest.
PYQ-2022-AP-183.e: Difference in interest = P × n × (r₁ − r₂) / 100 ⇒ 13.50 = 1500 × 3 × d / 100 = 45d ⇒ d = 0.3%.

PYQ-2022-GS-184.q: Which of the following is wrongly matched?
o: Article 17 – Equality of opportunity in public employment
Article 26 – Freedom to manage religious affairs
PYQ-2022-GS-184.e: Article 17 abolishes untouchability; equality of opportunity in public employment is in Article 16. So the second pair is wrong. Article 14 (equality before law), 21A (right to education for ages 6–14) and 26 (managing religious affairs) are correct.

PYQ-2022-GS-185.q: The Directive Principles of the Indian Constitution resemble the ________.
PYQ-2022-GS-185.e: Ambedkar said the Directive Principles are like the 'Instrument of Instructions' issued to Governors under the Government of India Act, 1935; the difference is that these are instructions to the legislature and the executive.

PYQ-2022-GS-186.q:
Match:
(a) Sarkaria Commission – 1. Tamil Nadu Government
(b) Rajamannar Committee – 2. Akali Dal
(c) Anandpur Sahib Resolution – 3. Supreme Court
(d) Bommai judgment – 4. Central Government
PYQ-2022-GS-186.e: Sarkaria Commission (1983) – set up by the Central Government (4); Rajamannar Committee (1969) – set up by the Tamil Nadu Government (1); Anandpur Sahib Resolution (1973) – Akali Dal (2); S.R. Bommai judgment (1994) – Supreme Court (3). Hence 4, 1, 2, 3.

PYQ-2022-GS-187.q:
Match correctly.
(a) Consumer Protection Act – 1. 1980
(b) Legal Metrology Act – 2. 1955
(c) Essential Commodities Act – 3. 2009
(d) Prevention of Black Marketing Act – 4. 1986
PYQ-2022-GS-187.e: Consumer Protection Act – 1986 (4); Legal Metrology Act – 2009 (3); Essential Commodities Act – 1955 (2); Prevention of Black Marketing and Maintenance of Supplies of Essential Commodities Act – 1980 (1). Hence 4, 3, 2, 1.

PYQ-2022-GS-188.q:
Match (Gupta period).
(a) Varahamihira – 1. Physician
(b) Kalidasa – 2. Lexicographer
(c) Amarasimha – 3. Sanskrit poet
(d) Dhanvantari – 4. Astronomer
PYQ-2022-GS-188.e: Varahamihira – astronomer (Brihat Samhita) (4); Kalidasa – Sanskrit poet (Shakuntalam) (3); Amarasimha – lexicographer (Amarakosha) (2); Dhanvantari – physician (1). They are called the 'Navaratnas' of Vikramaditya's court.

PYQ-2022-GS-189.q: Christianity was brought to India in the 1st century CE by ________, a disciple of Jesus.
PYQ-2022-GS-189.e: By tradition, St. Thomas, one of the twelve apostles of Jesus, arrived on the Kerala coast in 52 CE and spread Christianity; he is believed to have died at Mylapore (Santhome), Chennai.

PYQ-2022-GS-190.q:
Arrange the following languages by the year they received classical language status.
1. Sanskrit
2. Telugu
3. Malayalam
4. Tamil
PYQ-2022-GS-190.e: Tamil (2004) → Sanskrit (2005) → Telugu (with Kannada, 2008) → Malayalam (2013). Hence 4, 1, 2, 3.

PYQ-2022-GS-191.q: Which of the following is a right-bank tributary of the Narmada river?
PYQ-2022-GS-191.e: Right-bank tributaries of the Narmada: Hiran, Orsang, Barna, Kolar. Left-bank tributaries: Burner, Banjar, Sher, Shakkar, Tawa (the largest), Kundi. So the Hiran is the right-bank tributary.

PYQ-2022-GS-192.q:
Match the excavation sites with their districts.
(a) Keezhadi – 1. Thoothukudi
(b) Korkai – 2. Ariyalur
(c) Gangaikonda Cholapuram – 3. Thanjavur
(d) Kurumbanmedu – 4. Sivagangai
PYQ-2022-GS-192.e: Keezhadi – Sivagangai (4); Korkai (Pandya port) – Thoothukudi (1); Gangaikonda Cholapuram – Ariyalur (2); Kurumbanmedu – Thanjavur (3). Hence 4, 1, 2, 3.

PYQ-2022-GS-193.q: Which city is called the 'Electronic Capital of India'?
PYQ-2022-GS-193.e: Bengaluru, the hub of electronics and software industries, is called the 'Electronic Capital of India' (and also the 'Silicon Valley of India').

PYQ-2022-GS-194.q:
Match the electrical components of a circuit with their uses.
(a) Galvanometer – 1. To regulate the amount of current flowing in the circuit
(b) Voltmeter – 2. To measure current
(c) Ammeter – 3. To measure potential difference
(d) Rheostat – 4. To detect current and its direction
PYQ-2022-GS-194.e: Galvanometer – detects whether current flows and its direction (4); voltmeter – potential difference (3); ammeter – current (2); rheostat – regulates the amount of current (1). Hence 4, 3, 2, 1.

PYQ-2022-GS-195.q: When was the first National Policy on Education formulated?
PYQ-2022-GS-195.e: Based on the recommendations of the Kothari Education Commission (1964–66), the first National Policy on Education was formulated in 1968 by the Indira Gandhi government. The second was in 1986 (Rajiv Gandhi) and the third in 2020.

PYQ-2022-GS-198.q:
Which of the following statements is/are wrong?
Political rights include:
(1) The right to vote
(2) The right to hold public office
(3) Not criticising the government
PYQ-2022-GS-198.e: The right to vote, the right to contest elections/hold public office, and the right to criticise the government are political rights. 'Not criticising the government' is not a right; it goes against freedom of expression — so only (3) is wrong.

PYQ-2022-GS-199.q:
In what order does Valluvar list the ornaments of a country?
(1) Wealth (2) Happiness (3) Security (4) Freedom from disease (5) Produce
PYQ-2022-GS-199.e: 'பிணியின்மை செல்வம் விளைவின்பம் ஏமம் அணியென்ப நாட்டிற்கிவ் வைந்து' (Kural 738, Naadu). Order: freedom from disease, wealth, produce, happiness, security = 4, 1, 5, 2, 3.

PYQ-2022-GS-200.q: What does Valluvar say are the best ornaments of a person?
PYQ-2022-GS-200.e: 'பணிவுடையன் இன்சொலன் ஆதல் ஒருவற்கு அணியல்ல மற்றுப் பிற' (Kural 95, Iniyavaikooral). Humility and sweet speech are a person's true ornaments; nothing else is.
